messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman stands facing the camera, then raises her arms and spins around, showing her back before turning back to face forward.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium shot that remains fixed on the character throughout the clip.","clothing":"A bright pink, off-the-shoulder long-sleeved top with dark purple accents on the shoulders.","hair_color":"Bright blonde.","hairstyle":"Short, spiky blonde hair that is later tied into a small ponytail.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark skin and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"An outdoor, dilapidated industrial area with a weathered wooden boat on the left, scattered wooden planks, and rusty metal structures in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output begins with a frontal medium close-up of the woman's face in a new industrial dock environment, matching the reference framing. She then raises her arms and spins, showing her back before returning to face the camera. The outfit, blonde hair, and action progression are broadly retained, but the environment is no longer the source's seaside platform with wooden posts.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a close-up frontal shot of the person's face, using the reference for viewing direction, placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, appearance, outfit, expression, action, environment, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the facial expression and action timing exactly match the source video.
unexpected_changes: The environment was changed from the source's open seaside platform to a cluttered industrial dock with a boat and wooden planks.
The framing is a medium close-up rather than a tight close-up of the face.
